script.vo01: There's an agent to guide services firms through these processes. It pulls data from The delivery system and Timesheets, engages you directly in Microsoft Teams.
script.vo02: Before, they would have needed to jump across multiple systems to manually gather insights, and automatically highlight what needs attention first.
script.vo03: It reads the delivery system, Timesheets. It engages you in Microsoft Teams and Outlook. And it can draft the requirement or innovation record in the structure, showing the reasoning behind every answer.
script.vo04: Let's say a manager needs to draft the requirement or innovation record in the structure. But what if the manager wants to go a step further? The agent handles the analysis and offers a set of targeted recommendations right in their workflow. Work like this used to require cross-referencing different systems by hand.
script.vo05: Now, with unified data context across The delivery system and Timesheets, the agent can rapidly generate a phased plan with quick wins. For risk mitigation, the agent helps as well, outlining a strategy that keeps the work on track. When the detail is needed, they simply ask, and the agent quickly compiles a clear summary.
script.vo06: It is explicit about what it did not read, so nobody mistakes a gap in the sources for a clean result. It names what it needs from a person before anything is written back, and who owns each step. And it says what would change its answer, which is the difference between a briefing you can act on and one you have to re-check. It can go further in the same conversation, without anyone switching tools.
script.vo_payoff: Finally, the agent creates a monitoring plan, so teams keep the effort aligned to the metrics they are measured on.
script.vo_helps: The result? Work that moves faster, stays consistent, and holds the same standard every time it runs.
script.vo_cta: Get started on your agentic journey today. Talk to your Microsoft representative to learn more.
